jobs.description:
Our technological architecture must run alongside and support our business goals at Sopra Steria, and IT Architects make that happen by creating blueprints for software, hardware, networks, and data systems. Security and efficiency are safeguarded as IT Architects conduct risk assessments and ensure regulatory compliance. As an IT Architect, you’ll take the long view with a strategic planning mindset, deep technical knowledge, and strong problem-solving skills. Scalability as we work towards digital transformation is crucial, as we collaborate with stakeholders to adopt new technologies. 

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problemsolving skills and commitment to continuous learning. 

 

Your profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! You have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Fullstack .NET development
• Git
• Docker
• Azure
• Kubernetes
• Event-driven
• N-tier
• Onion architecture
• Coaching people
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• 
Languages: English and Dutch or French

Your impact as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

The Utilities market is in full transition. At Sopra Steria, we are enthusiastically participating in the digital acceleration within this sector through our Industry and Services market. We aim to grow our advisory agency for Utilities, helping our clients efficiently deal with both current and future challenges in energy transition and sustainable resource management by optimizing processes, improving asset utilization, and enhancing customer experiences.

Your role & responsibilities as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

As a Business Enterprise Architect, you will occupy a key position, crucial to growing our advisory agency within the utilities sector. You will play a significant role in expanding our Industry and Services market, and in executing our strategy to become the preferred digital business partner of our clients by 2026. Your role will be key in architecting digital solutions and strategies that put our clients at the forefront of the energy transition and smart utility management in a rapidly evolving market while driving the growth of our advisory services.

• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for energy, water, and waste management utilities.
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as (Transformation consulting, cybersecurity, Data & AI, applications & integrations, cloud & infrastructure).
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives.
• Actively contribute to growing our advisory agency by identifying new opportunities and expanding our client base in the utilities sector.
• 
Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Utilities sector, with a focus on digital transformation and sustainability.

 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation / Business Enterprise Architect :

• Min 10 years’ experience of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Utilities sector.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus.
• Proven track record in digital transformation initiatives, particularly in the energy sector and or water management projects.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes specific to utilities (e.g., Smart Grid, Energy Transition, Water Management Systems).
• Professional network in the Utilities sector.
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in utilities, especially in areas of sustainability and resource efficiency.
• Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development in the evolving utilities landscape.
As a member of one of Europe’s largest digital solutions providers, you’ll benefit from extensive career development opportunities, both local and international. At the Sopra Steria Academy, you’ll be part of a dynamic network of 56,000 professionals at all stages of their careers. With a wide array of offices to explore, you can find your ideal location and take the next step in your career. You’ll become a part of a major Tech player in Europe recognised for its consulting, digital services, and software development

As a data engineer, you will help our clients with building a variety of data applications in the cloud. Your role will involve working with the latest technologies to develop and manage data solutions tailored to their needs. Your responsibilities include the following: 

• Gather business requirements and translate them to technical specifications. 
• Design, implement and orchestrate scalable and efficient data pipelines to collect, process, and serve large datasets. 
• Apply DataOps best practices to automate testing, deployment and monitoring. 
• 
Continuously follow & learn the latest trends in the data world

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 
airline and MICE guests. 
Are you a commercial hunter with a passion for hospitality? Do you thrive on winning new business, building strategic partnerships and leading high-performing sales teams? We're looking for an ambitious Director of Sales to lead the commercial strategy of our international hotel. This isn't an account management role— 
it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll doYou'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by: 
• Leading and inspiring a team of business developers with a strong hunting mindset. 
• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 
• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 
• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships. 
• Using CRM and performance data to build a strong commercial pipeline and deliver measurable results. 
• With the help of a marketing officer and/or an agency, leverage digital marketing, content and social media to fuel lead generation, reinforce brand identity and support commercial growth. 
• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 
• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 
• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage. 
• Commercially driven, analytical and results oriented. 
• Comfortable using CRM tools and managing a structured sales pipeline. 
• Fluent in French and Dutch. English is a big asset.

jobs.occupation: CE truck driver for national transport - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.description:
Deluge is seeking a creative and hands-on Content Creator to strengthen our brand presence and tell our story across digital channels. 
 

 As our Content Creator, you will:

• Create and edit high-quality photo and video content for campaigns, product launches, and day-to-day storytelling. 

• Coordinate and manage content creation for digital platforms, newsletters, PR, and print materials. 

• Collaborate with external parties to create high-end content.

• Monitor trends and translate them into creative concepts for luxury audiences.

• Create website visuals, and other marketing materials, such as newsletters. 

• Support influencer collaborations and event coverage.

•  Organize and promote events, brand activations, and partnerships.

• You’re skilled in photography, videography, and editing tools. 

• You understand social media trends and know how to adapt them to a luxury brand voice. 

•  You have experience managing social media, newsletters, and website content. 

• You’re proactive, detail-oriented, and full of ideas. 

• You’re fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You understand influencer marketing and community building.

Financial Controller ready to make an impact in a fast-paced and growing environment.
 

In this role, you act as a key link between finance and operations. You analyze financial performance, monitor the balance sheet, and provide clear insights and recommendations to management. You will also play an active role in improving processes and profitability.
 

Your responsibilities
